verdict.rationale: The portal says multiple filings on multiple entities can be processed through one Online Account, and it offers Data and Image Subscriptions, which suggest bulk data retrieval. Neither shows a true bulk action, such as submitting or updating many filings in one operation. The filing rail sits behind a standard credential login, with no documented programmatic batch interface. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or batch filing operation, an API or programmatic batch interface for agents, details on subscription data scope and format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
